description.en: Opens a full-screen movie file by path, returning a handle to poll with CMND_MOVIE_IS_LOADING before playing it with CMND_MOVIE_PLAY. Never called from any shipped script in script_clean/; behavior reconstructed from the native implementation, mirroring the CMND_SND_OPEN_*/CMND_SND_PLAY pattern.
Path to the movie file to open.

example.code:
// Open a full-screen movie file
local hMovie = CMND_MOVIE_OPEN("data/movie/op.mvd");
